svg.title: SlabRail wiring block diagram
svg.desc: Power chain from mains through the 24 V supply, E-stop and fuses to the Rodent and the MOSFET modules; Raspberry Pi 5 control and sensor wiring; Rodent to motors, switches, probe and the drag chain. Wire numbers match docs/WIRING.md.
svg.text: Wire numbers (W…) match docs/WIRING.md. Lines that cross without a dot are not connected. Every box on the 24 V side also has a black 0 V wire to the 0 V bus.
(mains side: have an instructor check it)
Pi 5: own 27 W USB-C supply in its own wall socket.
Never powered from the 24 V system (stays on during E-stop).
all go to the 0 V bus.
B Raspberry Pi 5: control and sensors
Gate: laser in the left post, receiver in the right post, beam 4 mm above MAX.
A cut receiver wire pulls GPIO5 LOW (= blocked), so the run won't start.
Sensor DIP-6: pins 2+4 = 5 V, 3+6 = GND, 5 = OUT, 1 = N/C (leave floating).
At atmosphere expect OUT ≈ 4.5 V and A0 ≈ 3.0 V. ADS1115 runs on 3.3 V.
Head camera USB and the Q4 head-LED pair run through the drag chain (panel C).
C Rodent ↔ machine (drag chain and moving head)
X-MAX gpio.35 ← X home sw. (NC, W52)
Z-MAX gpio.33 ← Z top switch (NC, W53)
X motor · right end of beam
X home sw. · left end, C+NC
X drag chain · 15 × 30 mm inside, 1 m
probe 3 · Z sw 2 · head LED 2 · spare 1
USB 2.0 ext. 3 m: Pi → head camera
PU tube 4 mm OD: valves → cup
Shields to Rodent GND at the board end only.
Tie every cable at both chain ends,
Head LED pair comes from Q4 (panel B).
Z loop: spiral wrap, about 350 mm, bend radius ≥ 40 mm
Z motor (top of Z spine) · socket Z
Z top switch (spine top), C+NC · Z-MAX
Optical probe on head foot · Y-MAX
slot clear at rest, so a cut wire = triggered
Cup + spring buffer · leave 30 mm tube slack
Never plug or unplug a motor while the board has 24 V.
Sockets Y and E are spare drivers that copy X and Z: leave them empty. All switches are wired NC, so a broken wire reads as triggered.
The X switch must click with the cup ≈ 23 mm left of pocket 0's centre; the Z switch at c ≈ 258 mm (FIRMWARE.md step 6).
dashed box = moves with the X carriage
